name: slate-markdown-editor
description: Slate Markdown editor component. src/ is bundled with CodeMirror into slate.js.

scripts.build: npm run build:slate && npm run build:mermaid
scripts.build:slate: esbuild src/slate.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --legal-comments=eof --banner:js="/* Slate Markdown Editor. Built from src/ by npm run build: edit src/, not this file. */" --outfile=slate.js
